logicalContent.note: the file digest can change on a WAL checkpoint without any business value changing; this digest covers the rows themselves

checklist.name: A
checklist.requirement: every active review carries the Rust-confirmed best amount raw, the measurement flag, the signed PnL raw, the currency and precision, the source, the route identity, the snapshot version and the review time

checklist.name: B
checklist.requirement: no mainnet best_amount_missing and no data_incomplete; a complete review has zero missing values; not_executable keeps its real reason and does not fake a profit

checklist.name: C
checklist.requirement: a measured zero counts as a valid zero; a ladder that never ran, or a Rust result that never arrived, stays a missing value

checklist.name: D
checklist.requirement: the Manager/legacy merge is unique for the same route and keeps the explicit amount and profit facts; a missing Manager hop table does not crash

checklist.name: E
checklist.requirement: re-run the reviews and verify the freshness is inside the 600 second window

observations.note: the stored reviews were written on 2026-11-19, so the 600 second freshness window is NOT met. A fresh review run is a WRITE action, so it needs its own explicit authorisation and was not performed here. The freshness item is therefore UNMEASURED, not passed.
